observation.summary: Existing native rules/tests have no shared bounded experiment ledger and revision-bound comparable Code-First probe protocol.

evidence.statement: Dependency-free native state rules provide a low-cost probe boundary without rewriting game logic.
Existing assertions already protect native game behavior and can host focused causal evidence.

evidence.symbol: root tree / Fast DEV execution contract
evidence.statement: Root tree has no .autonomous entry; existing final-head Actions and fixed Fast DEV ceiling must be reused.

hypothesis.cause: Observations, tests and merge evidence lack a common durable experiment identity and same-condition comparison contract.
hypothesis.prediction: The existing hosted validation can reconstruct both native probe reports, reject incomparable/stale evidence, and retain both games learning without browser or new Actions cases.
hypothesis.falsifier: Same-input nondeterminism, silent condition mismatch, loss of historical records, or acceptance of an unvalidated/moved head.

candidates.reason: Uses current pure rules and focused test/build lane; no game logic or workload graph rewrite.
Disproportionate to available native probe boundaries; unnecessary risk to established rules.

implementation.summary: Add charter, evidence ledger, immutable history guard, bounded lookup, native probes/comparison and final-head receipt gate. Do not change gameplay.

before.summary: Native rules exist; shared code-first protocol/ledger absent.

limitations: Hosted results and exact merge are recorded by PR receipt after validation, not assumed in this commit.
Initial probes cover native partial state rules, not full-game combat, visuals, feel or enjoyment.

learning.summary: Use existing native state boundaries; document coverage gaps instead of inventing gameplay defects. Await hosted receipt for measured outcomes.

doNotRetry.reason: No evidence that whole-engine rewriting is required.
doNotRetry.reconsiderWhen: A narrowly measured issue proves existing native boundaries insufficient and explicit scope authorizes it.

doNotRetry.reason: Normal iterations exclude costly browser execution.
doNotRetry.reconsiderWhen: User explicitly requests a separate browser task or existing mandatory gate requires it.

unresolved: Full combat/interaction causal coverage outside the leaf probes remains unmeasured.
next: Inspect one existing game-system connection using charter source map and current user feedback.
